model_output.rationale: All four lines carry CO-16; claim-level MOA N286 names the defect: missing/invalid referring provider identifier. The 837P lists billing and rendering providers but no referring provider loop. Claim adjudicated (CLP07 present, 277CA A2), filing indicator MB — Part B FFS vehicle is a clerical-error reopening; frequency 7 is rejected on Part B either way.

root_cause.explanation: CO-16 on all four lines; claim-level MOA N286 = missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier. The 837P carries no referring provider loop — only billing (85) and rendering (82) providers are present.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring provider name and NPI; verify enrollment in PECOS. MB/Part B adjudicated denial — frequency 7 is rejected; vehicle is a clerical-error reopening citing ICN 2626660924906. Do not appeal.

evidence.fact: All four service lines carry CO-16 ($310.83 total); claim-level MOA N286 = missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier.
No referring provider loop in the 837P party list; only billing provider (85, NPI 1110692305) and rendering provider (82, NPI 1992501921) are present.
CLP07 = 2626660924906 confirms the claim was adjudicated; filing indicator MB = Medicare Part B FFS.
Status A2 (accepted for adjudication) — claim passed front-end edits and was adjudicated, not returned unprocessable; no MA130.

citations.rule: CO-16 + N286 = missing/invalid referring provider; correct_and_resubmit to same payer; verify name + NPI in NPI Registry and PECOS.
Part B adjudicated denial with clerical error → clerical-error reopening; frequency 7 rejected on Part B FFS; emit as correct_and_resubmit with vehicle named in detail.
